note: skcode is a distributed feature with no single source repo yet (the daemon is skharness, the client is skchat-app, the operator adapter is skcapstone). Unlike the skos docs viewer, skcode's /docs.html is a static, self-contained page grounded in ADR-0001 and the skcode design spec, so there is no GitHub docs/ folder to render live. When skcode is packaged into its own repo, this manifest and docs.html will point at it.
